verdict.rationale: Vanta ships an official MCP server (and agentskills.io skill files) so AI assistants like Claude, Cursor, Perplexity, and Codex can query controls, surface failing tests, and remediate issues via natural-language prompts against the live Vanta API — a direct enablement of natural-language operation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports validating the MCP experience beyond vendor docs, and detail on the breadth of natural-language actions supported versus read-only queries.
